Name: Eliab, Son of Pallu
Summary: Eliab, son of Pallu, was the father of Dathan and Abiram, the Reubenites who joined Korah's rebellion.
KeyStory: Eliab's sons Dathan and Abiram rose against Moses and were swallowed by the earth with their households.
LifeLesson: A father's grief can be the warning a whole people needs to hear.
